searchText: Hey! Do you mean this PR? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5592 Very cool result indeed! I haven't dug into the details yet, for latency reduction, it's less RTP that matters since we can always shrink the per block gas limit to maintain throughput while partitioning the work in smaller chunks, but the latency of recursion, which is a cost paid for each chunk of work (and so shorter slots => more chunks => more fixed overhead => less room to scale down per block gas limit while maintaining throughput). on this, yes it's a similar reasoning to the gas limit: independently from a slot time reduction, we may want to increase the blob throughput. it's possible (though maybe unlikely?) that the throughput increase we want is 20% given a slot time decrease of 16.6%. if it is, then we don't need to change the blob schedule. as a note, ethlabs / <@421767904053297152> is working on a survey to uncover the blob capacity that is demanded but not currently supplied. we should have clearer expectations after this pretty sure he means https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5743 5743 has all the bug fixes from Jihoon's pr + some extra tests local kurtosis run: ```yaml participants_matrix: el: - el_type: ethrex el_image: ethpandaops/ethrex:heze-devnet-2 cl: - cl_type: lodestar cl_image: ethpandaops/lodestar:unstable supernode: true - cl_type: teku cl_image: ethpandaops/teku:heze-devnet-2 supernode: true - cl_type: lighthouse cl_image: ethpandaops/lighthouse:heze-devnet-2 supernode: true count: 2 network_params: preset: minimal gloas_fork_epoch: 0 heze_fork_epoch: 1 slot_duration_ms_heze: 5000 additional_services: - spamoor - dora global_log_level: debug dora_params: image: ethpandaops/dora:master ``` <:LFG:1083412070436982864> 5718, 5743 are the PRs i was talking about (the ones moving to heze atm)

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content:
local kurtosis run: 
```yaml
participants_matrix:
  el:
    - el_type: ethrex
      el_image: ethpandaops/ethrex:heze-devnet-2
  cl:
    - cl_type: lodestar
      cl_image: ethpandaops/lodestar:unstable
      supernode: true
    - cl_type: teku
      cl_image: ethpandaops/teku:heze-devnet-2
      supernode: true
    - cl_type: lighthouse
      cl_image: ethpandaops/lighthouse:heze-devnet-2
      supernode: true
  count: 2

network_params:
  preset: minimal
  gloas_fork_epoch: 0
  heze_fork_epoch: 1
  slot_duration_ms_heze: 5000

additional_services:
  - spamoor
  - dora

global_log_level: debug

dora_params:
  image: ethpandaops/dora:master
```
